messages:
Maria: @team - escal from customer acct_221. Invoice INV-2026-04 shows 720 reserved GPU hours charged for Apr but Dedicated > Usage dashboard only reports 480 reserved hours. Customer reports token burn was low all month. They want reconciliation and possible credit.

Raj: Can you paste acct id + commit id + pool id? Also which invoice line item ID?

Maria: acct_221
commit: commit_9f3b
pool: pool-us-west-2-gpuA
invoice line: INV-2026-04-L1
Attached: https://invoices.redwood/acct_221/INV-2026-04

Jin: I'll pull ledger. Quick note: last deployed metering change (2026-04-03) had a migration that changes how warmup-counting was aggregated. Could be related.

Jin: Ran a quick query:
```
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) day, event_type, SUM(hours) hours
FROM reserved_ledger
WHERE account_id='acct_221' AND commit_id='commit_9f3b' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;
```
Results (abridged):
2026-04-04 | warmup | 240
2026-04-05 | reserved | 480
Total billed hours = 720
Dashboard shows reserved=480, warmup=0

Elaine: That warmup 240 seems wrong. Dashboard should include warmup only as warmup (not billed against commit hours). Looks like invoice rolled warmup into reserved billing bucket.

billing-bot: invoice-generator v3 completed for INV-2026-04 at 2026-05-02T03:12Z

Raj: Action plan: (1) create investigative ticket BILL-478 and attach ledger query + raw rows (Jin, please upload). (2) Provision provisional credit for 240 hours to acct_221 to match dashboard while we investigate. (3) If root cause is migration bug, patch metering and run backfill/repair for affected invoices.

Jin: Uploaded raw rows to internal storage: s3://redwood-recon/acct_221/commit_9f3b/2026-04-raw.csv
Initial hypothesis: migration double-counted warmup events during instance failover (warmup event emitted + reserved eviction event) and invoice job collapsed event_type to 'reserved' during aggregation.

Maria: Replied to customer: "We see discrepancy; provisioning provisional credit for 240 reserved-hours while we investigate. Ticket BILL-478 opened; will update by EOD PT tomorrow. Apologies for inconvenience." :handshake:

sre-oncall: tagging eng-runtime for triage — possible race in metering pipeline. @eng-runtime pls advise.

Jin: I'll try to reproduce on staging: steps to reproduce:
1) Create reserved commit (same config).
2) Start a workload to trigger instance spin-up then force instance termination (kill -9) to trigger warmup/eviction race.
3) Run metering pipeline locally:
```
python tools/metering/ingest.py --from=2026-04-04 --to=2026-04-05 --account=acct_221 --commit=commit_9f3b
```
Observe whether warmup events get coalesced into reserved bucket.

Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll confirm provisional credit applied and update customer once we have root cause or patch.
